tagline: Leading manufacturer of innovative medical devices and implantable tissues for cardiac and vascular surgical procedures.
hero_kpi_rationale: Aortic stent graft revenue is a key driver of the product portfolio and reflects growth in aortic disease solutions, with a year-over-year increase of 29%, demonstrating strong demand for innovative endovascular solutions.

kpis.name: Aortic Stent Grafts Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of aortic stent grafts including thoracic and abdominal aortic prostheses
kpis.description: Aortic stent graft revenue is a key performance indicator for the company in the medical devices sector, representing 36% of total 2025 revenue
kpis.signal: Significant growth in aortic stent graft revenue

kpis.name: On-X Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of On-X mechanical valves and related surgical products
kpis.description: On-X revenue is a key performance indicator for the company in the medical devices sector, representing 23% of total 2025 revenue

kpis.name: Surgical Sealants Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of surgical sealants, notably the flagship BioGlue product
kpis.description: Surgical sealants revenue is a key performance indicator for the company in the medical devices sector, representing 17% of total 2025 revenue
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in surgical sealants revenue

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue including all preservation products and services
kpis.description: Total revenue reflects overall company growth across all product and service segments, with product revenues increasing 19% and preservation services declining 3%

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income for the company for fiscal year 2025
kpis.description: Net income of $9.8M in 2025 demonstrates company profitability, although impacted by the Q4 2024 cybersecurity incident effects
kpis.signal: Positive net income despite cybersecurity incident impacts

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The Q4 2024 cybersecurity incident had a quantifiable impact on fourth quarter 2024 revenues, and the company remains vulnerable to future attacks

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict healthcare authority regulations for implantable medical products

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The cardiovascular medical devices market is highly competitive with established and emerging companies

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on external suppliers for raw materials and critical device components

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of revenues is generated in foreign currencies (EUR, BRL, GBP, CAD, CHF), creating exposure to exchange rate fluctuations. The weakened dollar in 2025 benefited revenues

risks.title: Product Risk
risks.score_rationale: Implantable medical devices carry inherent risks of product failure with potential for high liability and reputational impact
